item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 02/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring cool weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The monsoon is expected to moderate in the latter part of this week, temperatures will rise slightly over the region. Another replenishment of the northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China early to midweek next week, it will be persistently cool over the region.

Date/Month: 02/01 (Tuesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Visibility relatively low over some areas in the morning. Sunny periods during the day. One or two light rain patches at night.
Temp range: 17 - 20 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
